description: Define the ok/err envelope {ok, code, error, recovery, kind} where kind is gate (an expected in-band result to act on) or error (protocol/environment failure), carrying forward the Pi adapter's isError:!gate distinction. Add E_ codes for exception classes that currently have none: ProjectIdentityMismatchError, SchemaBehindError, SchemaDivergedError, AuditIntegrityError, and the _assert_writable OperationalError. Wire the existing E_NOTHING_READY on an empty-queue take and add a code for the stats drafts-dir raise. Notify BenchBox because parity diff_exit_codes tracks errors.py.
